2fa.codeFailed: The code could not be verified.
2fa.disableHint: Enter the current code from your authenticator app to turn it off.
2fa.intro: Works with an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy or 1Password. Codes are generated on your device and need no internet.
2fa.off.hint: Only your password protects the account.
2fa.on.hint: Signing in asks for your authenticator code as well as your password.
2fa.step1: Open your authenticator app and scan the QR code.
2fa.step2: If you cannot scan it, enter the key by hand.
2fa.step3: Type the 6-digit code from the app below.
2fa.title: Two-step verification
acc.status.hint: Your current visibility: {status}. If you leave the app in the background you become "Away" after 3 minutes.
app.address.hint: Currently in use: {current}. If the server address changes, type it here and apply; the app reloads. If you use a website address, append /api.
app.ask.hint: You are asked what to do each time you close.
app.minimize.hint: The window stays on the taskbar.
app.onClose: When you press the close button
app.quit.hint: Calls end and no notifications arrive.
app.tray.hint: The app keeps running in the background; calls and notifications continue.
keys.escape: Close the last thing opened (menu, panel, editing, quote)
keys.send: Send the message · apply the selection when suggestions are open
keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
lang.autoZone.hint: Your computer time zone is used: {zone}
lang.hour24.hint: When off, times are shown with am/pm
lang.languageHint: Menus, settings and notification text are shown in this language.
look.notTheme: This file is not a P2 theme.
look.sample: Sample: Hello, we are meeting in the team room today.
media.blocked: Microphone and camera are unavailable on this connection
media.echo.hint: Removes speaker output from your microphone
media.err.devices: Could not read the device list.
media.err.mic: Could not open the microphone. Check the device selection and permissions.
media.err.permission: Microphone access was denied. Check Windows > Privacy & security > Microphone and make sure desktop apps are allowed.
media.fillTest: Fill in the free test server
media.micHint: Say something; if the bar moves, your microphone works.
media.noise.hint: Reduces background sounds such as fans and keyboards
media.perm.body: The browser engine hides microphone and camera names until you grant access.
media.perm.title: Permission is required to see device names
media.relayOnly.hint: To check whether the TURN server really works; no direct connection is attempted.
media.stun.hint: Not needed for calls on the same network; used when connecting across networks.
media.turn.hint: Needed when audio does not flow to people behind strict firewalls or mobile data; it relays the audio. Everyone in the call must enter the same details.
media.turn.warn: The test server is public and means your audio passes through a third party; enter your own TURN server for permanent use.
notify.hint: Per-channel notification preference (all messages / mentions only / muted) is set from the bell icon in the channel header.
notify.sound.hint: Plays a short sound when a message arrives
notify.title: Notifications
sec.library.hint: Install location, auto download and activity
sec.voice.hint: Push to talk, push to mute
set.title: Settings
voice.hint: This key does not interfere with typing; it is only listened for outside the message box. Press Esc to cancel.
voice.open.hint: Your microphone stays on; you mute it with the mute button.
voice.ptm.hint: Your microphone is on; you go silent while you hold the key.
voice.ptt.hint: Your voice is sent only while you hold the key.
auth.lead: Gather your team, run your projects and work together.
auth.registerLead: Join to start working with your team.
auth.inviteHint: If you have a project invite code, enter it; you join that project once your account is created.
auth.codeHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.passwordRule: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit.
auth.err.twoFactor: The verification code is not valid.
auth.err.emailTaken: This email is already in use.
auth.err.inviteOnly: Registration on this server is invite-only; enter a project invite code.
auth.err.inviteNotFound: This invite code was not found.
auth.err.inviteInvalid: This invite code is no longer valid.
auth.err.banned: You are banned from this server.
auth.err.bannedReason: You are banned from this server. Reason: {reason}
mode.title: How do you want to start?
mode.joinHint: If your team already has a server, enter its address and sign in. Nothing to install.
mode.localHint: If the separate P2 Server app is installed on this computer, connect to the local server.
mode.changeLater: You can change this later in Settings > App > Server address.
mode.addressHint: The address shared by whoever set up the server. Nothing is installed on this computer; it only connects.
mode.notFound: No P2 server was found at this address. Check the address and that the server is running.
problem.title: We could not reach the server
problem.body: The saved server cannot be reached right now. Check the address or try again.
setup.title: Finish setting up P2
setup.passwordRule: The admin password needs at least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit.
setup.failed: The admin account could not be created.
setup.consoleHint: PostgreSQL and API settings are managed in the separate P2 Server Console app.
join.title: Join a project
join.lead: Enter the code a project admin shared with you. It only gives access to that project.
join.pasteHint: Paste the code and the project card appears here, so you can see which project you are joining.
join.reason.full: This invite has reached its use limit.
join.reason.invalid: This invite is no longer valid.
join.err.notFound: This invite code was not found. Check that you typed it correctly.
join.err.revoked: This invite code was revoked. Ask the project admin for a new one.
join.err.expired: This invite has expired. Ask the project admin for a new one.
join.err.full: This invite has reached its use limit. Ask the project admin for a new one.
join.err.banned: You are banned from this project and cannot join until the ban is lifted.
rail.createHint: Set up your own team and invite people
rail.createForbidden: You don’t have permission to create projects — ask a server admin
srv.title: Server admin
srv.failed: The action could not be completed.
srv.tab.projects.hint: Every project and the recycle bin
srv.users.title: Users · {n}
srv.users.hint: Every account on this server. Click someone to see their projects, server permissions and admin actions.
srv.users.ownerHint: The server owner has every permission; it cannot be changed.
srv.users.selfHint: You cannot change your own server permissions.
srv.users.needAdmin: You need to be a server admin to grant permissions.
srv.users.demoted: {name} is no longer a server admin.
srv.users.bannedNotice: {name} was banned and signed out everywhere.
srv.perm.server.view_all.hint: Sees every project, including ones they are not in.
srv.perm.server.ban.hint: Bans people from the server and lifts bans.
srv.perm.server.manage_projects.hint: Enters, transfers, deletes and restores any project.
srv.perm.server.settings.hint: Server name, sign-up and project rules.
srv.perm.server.admin.hint: Every server permission; can grant permissions.
srv.projects.title: Projects · {n}
srv.projects.hint: Every project on the server, including ones you are not in. Click a project for actions.
srv.projects.deleted: {name} was moved to the recycle bin.
srv.projects.needManage: These actions need the "Manage projects" server permission.
srv.projects.trashHint: Deleted projects wait here for 30 days; restore them or delete them forever.
srv.set.readOnly: You can view these settings; changing them needs the "Server settings" permission.
srv.set.name: Server name
srv.set.nameHint: The name of this installation, shown in the title and the admin panel.
srv.set.registrationHint: How new accounts can be created.
srv.set.regOpenHint: Anyone with the server address can create an account.
srv.set.regInviteHint: A project invite code is required to create an account.
srv.set.creationHint: Who can open new projects. The server owner always can.
srv.set.createPermissionHint: People you give the "Create projects" server permission.
srv.set.createEveryoneHint: Every account on the server can open projects.
srv.confirm.banBody: {name} will be signed out on every device and cannot sign in until the ban is lifted. Their project memberships are kept.
srv.confirm.sessionsBody: {name} will be signed out of every session on every device and must sign in again.
srv.confirm.reset2faBody: Two-step verification will be turned off for {name}; they can sign in with just their password.
srv.confirm.deleteBody: “{name}” will move to the recycle bin and members will lose access. You can restore it within 30 days.
srv.confirm.purgeBody: “{name}” (code: {slug}) and all its channels, messages, boards and tasks will be deleted permanently.
srv.confirm.transferBody: {user} will become the owner of “{name}”; the previous owner stays as a member.
